scriptsText.reap.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# Stops workerd processes that a finished test of this trial left behind: parent 1 and working folder one of this trial's own trees. Others are not touched.
n=0
for p in $(pgrep -x workerd); do
  pp=$(ps -o ppid= -p "$p" | tr -d ' '); cwd=$(readlink "/proc/$p/cwd" 2>/dev/null)
  case "$cwd" in */scratchpad/trialB|*/scratchpad/trialB-alt1|*/scratchpad/trialB-alt1b|*/scratchpad/trialB-neg) if [ "$pp" = "1" ]; then kill "$p" 2>/dev/null && n=$((n+1)); fi;; esac
done
echo "reaped $n"
